I don’t have a built‑in “get my open tickets” endpoint exposed here, so I’ll walk you through two common ways to pull them out: --- ### 1️⃣ Using the **Jira Web Interface** | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | 1 | Log into your Jira account. | | 2 | In the top navigation bar click **Issues** → **Search for Issues…** (or just hit `/issues/` if you’re already inside). | | 3 | Switch to *Advanced* mode (the little gear icon) and enter a JQL query that matches “open” status. Common examples:
```statusCategory != Done AND assignee = currentUser()```\nOr simply ```resolution = Unresolved``` if you want everything not yet resolved.
You can also add `AND project = XYZ` to limit to a single project. | | 4 | Hit **Enter** – Jira will show you a table of matching issues. You can export the result to CSV/XLSX via the **Export** button at the upper right corner. | If you prefer a quick view of *all* open work across the organization, try: ```jql issuetype in standardIssueTypes() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, updatedDate ASC ``` --- ### 2️⃣ Via the **REST API** (curl / Postman) #### Prerequisites - An OAuth/JWT bearer token or basic auth credentials (`username:password`). - Your Jira base URL (e.g., `https://your-domain.atlassian.net`). #### Example cURL request ```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash BASE_URL="https://your-domain.atlassian.net" API_TOKEN="YOUR_JWT_OR_BASIC_AUTH_TOKEN" # Basic Auth header (replace USERNAME & PASSWORD) AUTH_HEADER=$(printf "%s:%s\n" "USERNAME" "$API_TOKEN" | openssl enc -base64) curl -H "Authorization: Basic $AUTH_HEADER" \ -H "Accept: application/json" \ "${BASE_URL}/rest/api/3/search?jql=statusCategory!=Done&fields=summary,status,priority,resolutiondate,updated" \ --compressed > open_tickets.json ``` This pulls all unresolved tickets (i.e., those whose status category isn’t “Done”) and returns JSON with selected fields. Adjust the `fields=` parameter to suit your needs. #### Using JQL directly If you’d rather target a specific project or component: ```bash ... ?jql=project=ABC+AND+statusCategory!=Done+AND+component=UI ``` Add pagination parameters (`startAt`, `maxResults`) if you expect many records. --- ### Quick Tips | Tip | Why it helps | |-----|--------------| | Use **labels** or **components** in JQL to narrow down scope quickly. | Reduces noise and speeds up queries. | | Save frequently run searches as filters. | Click **Save As** after running a query—then share or schedule reports. | | Export to Excel for ad‑hoc reporting. | Great for dashboards outside Jira. | Let me know if you’d like help crafting a specific JQL expression or automating the export!
